content.title: What Time Is ‘Invincible’ Season 4 Coming Out? Here’s How To Watch
content.text: Bulletproof (Jay Pharoah), Robot (Zachary Quinto), Monster Girl (Kevin Michael Richardson), Brit (Jonathan Banks), Shapesmith (Ben Schwartz), Black Samson (Khary Payton)Courtesy of PrimeInvincible is back for Season 4, which is shaping up to be one of the most intense chapters yet for Prime Video’s hit adult animated superhero series. The fourth season picks up after a brutal battle in the Season 3 finale that pushed Mark Grayson closer than ever to becoming like his father.Based on the award-winning comic book series by Robert Kirkman, Cory Walker and Ryan Ottley, Invincible follows 17-year-old Mark as he learns to navigate his powers and the growing threats facing Earth. After breaking his no-kill rule in Season 3, Mark is more determined than ever to protect his loved ones, setting him on a dangerous path against new villains like Thragg, Dinosaurus and Universa.“While the world recovers from catastrophe, a changed Mark fights to protect his home and the people he loves, setting him on a collision course with a threat that could alter the fate of humanity forever,” Prime Video released about Season 4. “With the stakes and threats raised even higher this season, Invincible, Atom Eve, and the Guardians of the Globe must save the world.”ForbesThe Best New TV Shows Streaming In March 2026 On Netflix, Prime Video And MoreBy Monica MercuriIn a recent interview with TV Insider, Kirkman explained how the fourth installment marks a major turning point for Mark as he transitions from a coming-of-age hero into adulthood.MORE FOR YOU“I think it is very much a shift in the character, and I think it’s important to note that while this did start as a coming-of-age, teenage main character story, Mark is growing and aging in every season. He is very much moving into adulthood with this season,” Kirkman said. “He’s been learning, and he’s doing less learning and more doing this season, and I think that’s actually a fairly important progression.”Here’s everything to know about Invincible Season 4, including the release time, how to watch new episodes, the returning and new cast and a recap of how Season 3 ends.What Time Is Invincible Season 4 Coming Out On Prime Video?Omni-Man (JK Simmons), Oliver Grayson (Christian Convery), Invincible (Steven Yeun)Courtesy of Prime Email Address Invincible Season 4 premieres on Wednesday, March 18, at 3 a.m. ET / 12 a.m. PT on Prime Video.How Did Invincible Season 3 End?Steven Yeun (Invincible), Jeffrey Dean Morgan (Conquest)Courtesy of PrimeIn the Season 3 finale, a brutal, nearly 30-minute showdown unfolds between Mark and Conques, one of the most dangerous villains in the Invincible universe, who arrives to test Mark’s readiness for the Viltrumite Empire’s takeover. After Conquest severely injures Mark’s younger brother, Oliver, and nearly kills Atom Eve, Mark ultimately beats him to death, breaking his no-killing rule.Mark tells Cecil to incinerate Conquest’s body, but Cecil does the opposite. Instead, he secretly preserves Conquest in an underground facility, located 600 miles underneath the desert, hoping to learn information about the Viltrumite Empire when he eventually awakens.Invincible also visits Oliver at the hospital at the end of the episode. Mark admits to his half-brother that he was right about using lethal force against those trying to harm them. He vows to kill anyone who tries to threaten his family again.Following Season 3, Invincible is now in “a situation where things are pushing him to accept that he will need to become more like his father just to get by, which is putting him in a really dark position,” Kirkman teased to TV Insider.Who’s In The Invincible Season 4 Cast?Tech Jacket, Allen The Alien (Seth Rogen), Invincible (Steven Yeun), Great Thaedus (Peter Cullen), Oliver Grayson (Christian Convery), Omni-Man (JK Simmons), Battle Beast (Michael Dorn)Courtesy of PrimeSeason 4 will see the return of Steven Yeun as Mark Grayson/Invincible, Sandra Oh as his mother, Debbie Grayson, and J.K. Simmons as his father, Omni-Man.Also reprising their roles are Gillian Jacobs as Atom Eve, Seth Rogen as Allen, Walton Goggins as Cecil, Zazie Beetz as Amber, Zachary Quinto as Robot, Chris Diamantopoulos as Donald, Ben Schwartz as Shapesmith, Clancy Brown as Damien Darkblood, Jay Pharoah as Bulletproof, Matthew Rhys as Dinosaur and Mark Hamill as Art.Meanwhile, new additions to the cast include Danai Gurira as Universa and Lee Pace as Thragg, the evil ruler of the Viltrum Empire.How To Watch Invincible Season 4Atom Eve (Gillian Jacobs)Courtesy of PrimeInvincible is exclusively streaming on Prime Video. To watch Season 4 and previous seasons of the animated hit, you’ll need to sign up for an Amazon Prime membership, which costs $14.99 per month or $139 per year. Or, you can subscribe to Prime Video as a standalone service for $8.99 per month.Can You Watch Invincible Season 4 For Free?Yes, new subscribers can watch new episodes of Invincible for free. Amazon is currently offering a 30-day free trial of Prime. After the trial ends, students can receive a discounted rate of $7.49 per month or $69 per year for Amazon Prime.Check out the Invincible Season 4 trailer below.
